apps.name: Deeprowss Movie & Football
apps.tagline: Live football matches and the latest movies. No ads.
about: Deeprowss is a free Android app that puts today's football and the latest movies in one place. Open it to see which matches are live, what is coming up, and what to watch next, with no ads getting in the way.
Match times are shown in your own local time zone, so you never have to convert kickoff times again. Browse football highlights, jump into TV, or search the movies library by genre.

features.title: Live Events
features.text: Today's matches in one list, with live, upcoming and finished filters.

features.title: Highlights
features.text: Catch up on goals and key moments from the biggest competitions.

features.title: TV
features.text: Live channels inside the same app.

features.title: Movies
features.text: Search the library and filter by genre to find something to watch.

features.title: Your time zone
features.text: Kickoff times are converted to your local time automatically.

apps.name: Deeprowss Browser
apps.tagline: A fast mobile browser with ready-made links for visas, education, sport and online classes.
about: Deeprowss Browser is a mobile browser that comes with useful websites already organised for you. Instead of searching for the same pages again and again, open the home screen and tap the category you need.

Whether you are looking for visa sponsorship opportunities, study resources, sports, or online classes, the links are one tap away. Everything else works like the browser you already know, with tabs, an address bar and a downloads list.
